title: Transfer of unbounded exchange invertibility from cyclic coefficients
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, n a natural number with n·1_Λ=0, and let g', f', f, g be a cartesian square of schemes as in [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Suppose the canonical exchange of [def-kun-unbounded-exchange] is an isomorphism of functors on D(X_et, Z/nZ). Then, for every K in D(X_et, Λ) of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], its canonical Λ-coefficient exchange is an isomorphism. No properness hypothesis is needed for this coefficient comparison. Universe lifting is used to place both coefficient categories in the same universe.

source.place: Tag 0D6J(3), with the canonical mate coherence stated by lem-kun-unbounded-abelian-exchange-comparison; coefficient restriction from the proof of lem-kun-proper-base-change-torsion-ring

proof.text: The unit annihilation gives (n : Λ)=0 and hence ringChar Λ divides n. Construct the explicit homomorphism φ : ULift (ZMod n) →+* Λ as ZMod.castHom composed with ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom. Apply the assumed cyclic exchange isomorphism at the derived restriction of K along φ.
Apply the arbitrary-ring restricted exchange equivalence to transfer this component isomorphism to the image under derived restriction of the Λ-coefficient exchange.

The private proved reflection lemma uses the natural homology comparison for exact functors and sectionwise conservativity of restriction of scalars. Homology detects derived isomorphisms, so invertibility of the restricted exchange implies invertibility of the original exchange.

proof_origin.place: coefficient restriction via the explicit cyclic ring map; compare exchanges and reflect isomorphisms using homology
